paragraphs: In Derekh Eretz Zuta, end of chapter 9, he says in the name of Shmuel HaKatan: “This world is like the eyeball of a person.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole digital Vilna Derekh Eretz Zuta chapter 9 paragraph names Abba Issi ben Yochanan reporting in Shmuel HaKatan’s name and compares this world to the eyeball. Only Hyman’s supplied comparison is translated; the rest of the paragraph is not imported.
